games.name: Astrogeo
games.summary: Astrogeo is a fast-paced retro shooter with unlockable ships, strategic weapon swapping, and escalating waves of enemies and bosses. Upgrade wisely and fight for the highest score!

games.name: Baladins
games.summary: Baladins is a choose-your-own-story multiplayer game (1-4 players online) inspired by Role-Playing Games. A whole campaign with friends, packed in 1-hour sessions!

games.name: Book of Fei
games.summary: Lead adorable warriors to form an adventure team to work and adventure on the computer desktop. Defeat the warriors to save the world. Rich nurturing and collection elements, idle and slack off to earn money and fight monsters!

games.name: Breezy Bakes Simulator
games.summary: Run your own seaside Italian bakery, craft pizzas and breads, and enjoy, fun with up to 4 players online!

games.name: Brick by Brick
games.summary: A fast-paced fantasy brick-breaker where you control heroes with unique powers, unlock companions, and dodge deadly attacks. Build synergies, master chaos, and grow stronger with every run, all with just your mouse.

games.name: Bust Buddies
games.summary: Become the Bust God in this chaotic friendslop party game! Play with up to 8 buddies as you chisel, chainsaw, or slam together marble into questionable masterpieces guided by random prompts or your friends' terrible ideas.

games.name: Captain Puff MacFly
games.summary: Shmup Roguelite – Dodge Hell, Power Up, Repeat, Conquer Netunia’s Sky with Captain Puff MacFly!

games.name: CaveVox
games.summary: CaveVox — the ONLY first-person voxel roguelike with permadeath. Live as your character: descend into a deadly dungeon, fight monsters, gain loot, and return to the surface for your next descent. Each expedition is unique — solo or with a party of adventurers, your choices shape your journey.

games.name: Cavorite
games.summary: A wicked smart, 16-bit puzzler.

games.name: Chicken Fries
games.summary: Chicken Fries is a first-person restaurant simulator where you run a fast-food kitchen: prepare meals by hand, manage fryers and inventory, serve customers, and survive the daily chaos of a busy restaurant, one chicken at a time.

games.name: Colony 28
games.summary: Colony 28 is a raw piece of Czech gaming history. Step into the circuits of a malfunctioning android, defy your alien masters, and fight for humanity's remnants across 8 sprawling levels. Experience an authentic 90s sci-fi classic in its original Czech version.

games.name: Crazy Qualle
games.summary: Welcome to Crazy Qualle! The battle game that takes place in Qualle and where weapons fall from the sky!

games.name: Delirium: Echoes of the Domino
games.summary: Delirium: Echoes of the Domino is a supernatural roguelike where each placed domino alters a cursed board and unleashes echoes of ancient curses. Confront time-warped entities and break the cycle... or become part of it.

games.name: Detective Turtletop: Who Killed Harambe?
games.summary: The first AI detective game that doesn't cheat. Developed by a former Meta AI Engineer. Interrogate suspects using your own words to solve the murder of Harambe. Features procedurally generated cases, consistent hard logic, and a unique stress mechanic. You have 3 hours to find the truth.

games.name: Don't Go Up There
games.summary: Don’t Go Up There is a short game about exploring a cave system within an intimidating mountain, Schubert has to avoid shattering into a million pieces, make his way through twisting paths, and talk to various strangers who stand around in caves.

games.name: Dragon Arena
games.summary: Dragon Arena is a 5v5 third-person 3D MOBA focused on teamwork and strategy. Each team defends a dragon, and defeating it ends the match. Victory depends on class synergy, adaptation, and team coordination.

games.name: Drop Jump
games.summary: Test your reflexes in Drop Jump! Conquer extreme rhythm-based levels or build your own using the powerful Level Editor. Share your creations with the world and play endless community-made challenges in this neon-lit minimalist platformer.

games.name: Dude in the Dark
games.summary: 2D animated game where you are guided by smileys to complete each timed level.

games.name: Eleanor in Miami
games.summary: A stunning mix of visual novel and relationship-simulating elements as they make decisions that shape the main plot. Each character featured in the game has its unique storyline to discover, with various daily actions, stats, and events set in place to strengthen the gameplay experience.

games.name: Fear the Flesh
games.summary: A group of Antarctic researchers discover a perfectly preserved meteorite. Isolated in their remote base, their excitement turns into terror after a late-night experiment goes wrong.

games.name: Femdom First Timers
games.summary: Being a repeat customer really pays off, especially when your local love hotel hands out S&M starter kits! Sayuri straps in for spicy escapades and embraces her sadistic side, sliding into a sexy latex fit equipped with handcuffs, a collar, and even a cock of her own to peg her boyfriend with!

games.name: Fin-Tastic Battle
games.summary: A fixed wave shooter where a lonely old man defends his home from an ancient civilization of orcas that claims the land as their promised territory.

games.name: Glint's Revenge
games.summary: Glint’s Revenge is a retro platformer with a bold black-and-white aesthetic, where you play as Glint, an alien armed with a blaster on a quest through 10 deadly levels packed with traps, enemies, and clever puzzles. Shoot your way past relentless foes, flip levers to unlock hidden paths, and survive a gauntlet of challenges that demand quick reflexes and sharp thinking, all wrapped in a minimalist style that makes every move and every mistake stand out. A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks.

games.name: Hentai Archer
games.summary: Hentai Archer is an erotic puzzle game where you uncover seductive artwork of a beautiful elven archer by solving relaxing puzzles in a magical forest setting.

games.name: Highway Roads Racer
games.summary: Master the Curves. Own the Road.

games.name: Horripilant
games.summary: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon.

games.name: House of Nowhere
games.summary: Survive a merciless hunt in the House of Nowhere. Alone in a haunting home that no longer feels like your own, you must solve puzzles to escape into a vast, silent forest. Scavenge for your life and uncover the truth before the ancient thing hunting you turns your story into a forgotten legend.

games.name: Hummingbird Garden
games.summary: Hummingbird Garden is a charming pixel-art puzzle where you push little pollen nuggets through tight pathways until each flower blooms in a colorful display. It is the perfect mix of calm thinking, strategy, and a touch of natural magic.

games.name: I Have an Item
games.summary: "I Have an Item" is a quick, chaotic multiplayer game for 2-4 players about risks, rewards, and item manipulations. Each turn, players blindly draw items from a shared dynamic pool, facing a constant dilemma. End the turn and keep resources or risk and draw more which can lead to triggering dangerous items sabotaging their turn or damaging them. This creates a tense, push-your-luck dynamic where greed is rewarded or punished instantly.

games.name: Iconoclast
games.summary:
The Iconoclast is a powerful evil entity that no hunter has been able to kill.
It compromises buildings in the form of natural disasters, then feeds on the victims and creates a "nest" in the place for 88 days.

games.name: Idrscape
games.summary: Idrscape is a first-person solo game, search and analyze the clues to find the codes and keys that will allow you to get out of the building as quickly as possible.

games.name: Itzo
games.summary: ITZO is a retro style scrolling shooter and bullet hell game where you play as the best (and most ruthless) agent in space: ITZO! You have the mission to prevent an incoming interplanetary conflict… How are you going to do it? Easy. With bullets, destruction, chaos and no diplomacy!

games.name: Knock Knock!
games.summary: "Knock Knock!" is a horror experiment played with your ears, not your eyes. Navigate a pitch-black mansion using 3D binaural soundmarks to find the door. Designed for zero-visibility, featuring native menu narration for a fully accessible, high-tension experience for all players.

games.name: Lawnmower Game Battle 2: Reload
games.summary: Arena lawnmower game. Collect weapons and shoot and destroy other ai lawnmowers. Survive enough long win battles and collect stars

games.name: Let Her Go
games.summary: This story-based escape room game guides you through different rooms and realities.All quests form part of one big puzzle to solve for the main character James, creating a growing sense of tension.You'll find his thoughts and feelings illustrated in design and dialogs to fully dive into James' inner

games.name: Lethal Dungeon
games.summary:
Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

Using as few cards as possible will earn you more rewards, and if you get stuck on an enemy, you can use money to shuffle and draw.

Upgrade your deck using the money you earn! Defeat stronger enemies to earn more money! Repeat this process until you clear the dungeon!

games.name: LightQb
games.summary: Dash and survive in a grid-like world filled with colored light cubes, lasers, and portals, each with unique mechanics. Play, die, and repeat to master the fastest path to the finish. Time is not on your side.

games.name: Liquor Store Simulator
games.summary: Open your own Liquor Store! Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.

games.name: Loaders, Inc.
games.summary: Box by Box, Build Your Business

games.name: Maduro Run
games.summary: All you need to do in this game is simply run forward as fast as you can. Choose a suitable track and run forward, knocking down all obstacles in your path.

games.name: Misfit: The Rebirth of Death
games.summary: You wake up in a dark place... There's a green girl awaiting you... Enter The Gambling Game to help her to break out the simulation, but watch out... Something doesn't want you to stay.

games.name: Mitsume
games.summary: Mitsume is a cooperative horror game for two players where each participant controls a fragment of the same fractured psyche. Players must work together to investigate anomalies within a mental realm as they attempt to break free from an endless cycle of negativity.

games.name: Mortanis Prisoners
games.summary: Mortanis Prisoners - A survival horror game set in a Third Reich concentration camp where the camp's leadership, upon discovering a planned rebellion, orders the execution of all accomplices. Two main protagonists encounter an even more terrifying fate. Will they be able to escape the nightmare?

games.name: Obliterator-x
games.summary: A chaotic tower defense roguelike where scavenging is survival and death is just the beginning. Build, blast, and upgrade your way through mutant hordes, unlock new weapons, and assign combat drones to adapt your strategy every run.

games.name: Penguin Wars
games.summary: This is an adventure novel game. Movement and object selection are possible using only keyboard input and mouse clicks on a PC. Experience the story of a girl strolling through the night town, enhanced by captivating movies and music.

games.name: Piece of Ship
games.summary: A chaotic co-op game about fixing a sinking submarine with duct tape, one wrench, and terrible communication. Fix it together or drown screaming.

games.name: Plaser
games.summary: Plaser is an arcade shooter where you aim for the gaps between rotating asteroid belts to destroy planets. With auto-movement, use Dash and Attack to penetrate the debris shield and hit the core. Upgrade your Attack Power and Time Limit to extend your run and master the rhythm of destruction.

games.name: Plectra Spectre
games.summary: Nadia Svara is an unemployed guitarist who lives alone in a cramped apartment. She used to work in a band, but was unable to keep it together, and blames herself for the way it fell apart. Now at rock bottom, it's up to her to pick up the pieces. Can Nadia live a happy life again?

games.name: Prize Fighter: Heavyweight Edition
games.summary:
Originally developed by Digital Pictures, Prize Fighter returns!

Prize Fighter - Heavyweight Edition takes you closer than a ringside seat — it puts you right in the game. In this remastered Digital Pictures classic, you’re the one slugging it out with the best boxers in the world.

With your fists in view, you can throw any punch, anytime. A jab. A hook. An uppercut! Land a blow and watch your opponent reel.

When you take a punch, your vision rocks. You might even find yourself flat on your back, looking up into the faces of the referee and your trainer as you take the count. Or maybe you'll be up there accepting the heavyweight crown!

You’re fighting in the main event, attended by your trainer, cornerman and bucket boy. They guide you, help you, give advice. Also on hand: the referee, card girls, announcer, assorted hecklers, and four of the beefiest, brawniest, pug-ugly opponents you can imagine.

Prize Fighter is brooding, brutal, real! It has the impact of Martin Scorcese’s film Raging Bull. In fact, the bouts are staged by Ron Stein, the boxing guru who choreographed the fight scenes in Raging Bull and the Rocky films. Close-ups, point of view shots and handheld camera bring the intensity of the boxing scene right in your face!

Rebuilt from the ground up, Prize Fighter has been enhanced with 4K video along with numerous improvements and new features!

So pull on your gloves and get ready for tonight’s main event. You've got to beat three tough contenders to earn your shot at the champ.

games.name: Project C.U.R.E. Origins
games.summary: A Turn-Based RPG that follows the story of Kin on his journey to discover his past and the mysteries of this world. You, the player, must guide Kin and help him remember who he truly is and complete his mission.

games.name: Ragamuffins: Feline Fencers
games.summary: Unique item shop meets card battle game...with cats...with hats

games.name: Rainbow Unicorn Dash
games.summary: Collect your unicorn shoes to dash through enemies, gather hearts, unlock fun abilities, and climb the leaderboards!

games.name: Reaper's Ledger
games.summary: Manage souls, expand purgatory, and assist the Grim Reaper in this darkly humorous idle game. Tap to collect, automate the afterlife, unlock eerie upgrades, where progress never rests...and neither do the dead.

games.name: Rhythia
games.summary: Rhythia is a game about aiming and hitting musical beats with precision timing, within a dynamic 3x3 grid system. Use your reflexes to target flying blocks, combine accurate aim with perfect rhythm, and finally master the leaderboards against players who challenge your precision skills.

games.name: Room 601
games.summary: Room 601 is a 2D pixel puzzle survival game. You'll be a loner, trying to survive in room 601.

games.name: Rooster Saga: I Believe I Can Fly
games.summary: A fast-paced arcade action game where you play as a chubby rooster escaping a dangerous construction-zone turf, dodging bullets, and urban chaos in an endless, bullet-hell inspired run.

games.name: Scientist and Alchemist
games.summary: Edward Elric meets Alfons Heiderich, the two fall in love.

games.name: Sealchain
games.summary: The "Sealchain" is a roguelite game where items can be connected to each other to create chain reactions. In this crumbling world, you will play as a medium, using the power of curse seals to cleanse the world of post-apocalyptic evil spirits.

games.name: Shoot Pro Wrestling 2
games.summary: Shoot Pro Wrestling 2 puts you in control of your own wrestling federation, in this manager-style wrestling simulation game. You don't just pick winners though, you actually let your wrestlers battle it out in simulated "shoot" matches where every move matters. Can you give the fans what they want?

games.name: Slimepatch
games.summary: A cozy top-down arena survivor where you clear waves of slimes, upgrade your skills between rounds, and climb a rank ladder at your own pace. Relaxed, replayable combat with steady progression and an endless mode.

games.name: Slot Cave
games.summary: Spin the slots to build your deck and defeat your enemies!

games.name: Spy Guy Memory Fantasy
games.summary: Discover Spy Guy Fantasy Map!

games.name: Stillborn Slayer
games.summary: Stillborn Slayer is a beautifully crafted pixel-art bullet hell RPG game set in a cursed Dark Continent, with challenging boss fights, exploration, and complex combat. Master dodging and rolling skills to fight incomprehensible monsters and slay the Horned God to end the Curse.

games.name: Story of Love & Food
games.summary: "Huh?! Diabetes? Me?!"Fresh out of college and new to the workforce, Mi Lirong is shocked when her doctor warns her of diabetes and serious health risks. While night jogging to get back in shape, she bumps into He Siqiu, a mysterious and stunning fitness coach... who suddenly invites her to a hotel?

games.name: Strange and Luig
games.summary: Obviously, Luig has been hiding in strange places again…

games.name: Sujefa
games.summary: Sujefa is co-op puzzle platformer where two players can play as Rock, Paper or Scissors. Work together to solve puzzles and reach the end. Play online or locally on a shared screen.

games.name: Super Hoops 2
games.summary: Throw, dodge, and master endless hoops.

games.name: Survive Disasters Apocalypse
games.summary: Lava. Lasers. Tung Tung.

games.name: Swiftrace Canyon
games.summary: Find the fastest path to collect all flags and outpace the competition in this non-linear racing platformer. Master your skills on the hoverbike and become the champion of the Meerkat tribe. Drive the unique force mechanic to perfection to climb the leaderboards and prove that there can only be one fastest meerkat in the canyon.

games.name: Synergism
games.summary: Synergism is a free-to-play Idle game about... well, Synergy! Explore that concept through hundreds of upgrades, many reset layers and probably thousands of hours of content that allows both idle and active play.

games.name: The End Protocol
games.summary: In the fog-shrouded ruins, you will explore, gather, forge, and fight—within this dark Roguelike strategy game, cast the Dice of Fate, forge the ultimate relic, and face countless unspeakable foes. Every choice can turn the tide of battle, as you carve your own story through endless cycles of fate.

games.name: Tobiano
games.summary: Tobiano is a sport horse simulator with realistic genetics, management, and riding. Shop for horses and train them through the levels to succeed at shows or sell for profit. Breed horses with unique personalities and conformation. Grow your facility to add stables, farm feed, or craft tack.

games.name: Trick or Beat
games.summary: Stack your trick pile or beat up your opponent! Trick or Beat is a fair 1v1 battlecards game with a shared draw pile. Can you discover the best strategies? Without any pay to win!

games.name: Underfang
games.summary: Psychological horror game, we go through the dreams of a child. Well, maybe that's what we think at first glance.

games.name: Vindices: Beyond the Walls
games.summary: You are the lifeline of a struggling town. Enter dangerous, ever-changing regions through portals, fight enemies using a strategic turn-based combat system, gather resources, and return home to fulfill requests and help the town survive.

games.name: Voidblade
games.summary: An immersive 2D stealth platformer in which a Shadow Ninja must hide in and manipulate shadows using the power of the Void to sneak past deadly robots in space.

games.name: Welcome to Doll Town
games.summary: In "Welcome to Doll Town," explore a cursed village where lifelike dolls roam. Uncover dark secrets, solve eerie puzzles, and survive the haunted dollhouses to escape a twisted nightmare.

games.name: Where Time Ends
games.summary: Where Time Ends is a psychological puzzle game that follows a grieving protagonist determined to build a time machine to see his deceased mother one last time. As players construct the machine piece by piece, they must solve challenging puzzles while reality slowly begins to fracture. With nine unique endings that explore different interpretations of grief, obsession, and acceptance, the game offers an emotional and introspective experience that blends mystery, logic, and psychological tension.

games.name: Ys X: Proud Nordics
games.summary: Stand Proud for a new adventure in Ys X: Proud Nordics! Experience Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf with new quality of life improvements, then discover the new story centering around Öland Island, and the mysterious newcomers Canute and Astrid. And once you're ready, challenge yourself in the devious, time-trial dungeon of Muspelheim, where every second counts. Your new adventure awaits!

games.name: AonTheVoid Nevaeh
games.summary: Aonaran Nevaeh is a first-person psychological horror puzzle experience focused on exploration, observation, and environmental problem-solving. Investigate a quiet suburban block, interpret cryptic signals, and complete a session-based run where mistakes trigger escalating manifestations.

games.name: Behold the Horde
games.summary: An endless horde advances without rest. Survive infinite waves, dodge the chaos, and fight for the top spot on the online leaderboard.

games.name: Bubble Shot
games.summary: One smart shot - bubbles gone!

games.name: Chamber Shift
games.summary: Race through an infinitely changing dungeon and unleash overwhelming barrages with your own ultimate build in this high-speed roguelike shooting game. Combine weapons like shotguns and burst rifles with upgrades that bounce or explode bullets to create a combat style that's uniquely yours.

games.name: Colored Pencil Bakery
games.summary: A bakery management game where I grow wheat, bake bread, and sell it to animal customers. I run a bakery by making bread and selling it to animals in the forest.

games.name: Counter Force
games.summary: Lead your team, fight with honor, and rise as a hero.

games.name: Differences Master
games.summary: 【Differences Master】is a relaxing 3D miniature spot-the-difference game. Compare two seemingly identical little worlds, rotate and zoom to uncover hidden differences. No timer or penalties—take your time and enjoy the pure satisfaction of every discovery.

games.name: Empty the Ocean With a Bucket
games.summary: Drain an entire ocean one bucket at a time. Made by a kitchen chef in their free time. Relaxing, satisfying, and weirdly addictive. Bucket upgrades, collect the trash, achievements. Perfect for casual play or stream challenges.

games.name: Excidio The Kaiju Simulator
games.summary: Bring the cities of the world to their knees as a giant Kaiju. Featuring a fully destructible physics-based sandbox for you to lay waste!

games.name: Fall With Friends
games.summary: Fall With Friends is a physics-driven multiplayer party game where one player destroys a collapsing tower while the rest fight to stay on top. Dodge destruction, betray friends, and survive the fall. Only one remains.

games.name: Frost Vale
games.summary: Step into the cold. Explore the unknown.

games.name: Hentai Age Sci-Fi
games.summary: A magical, relaxing puzzle game where you arrange tiles to reveal stunning artwork of lovely girls, enjoy calming music, and progress through increasingly challenging levels at your own pace.

games.name: Human Bowling: King Pin
games.summary: Bowling with ragdoll humans

games.name: I'd Lowkey Simp for that Bussin Femboy at Work
games.summary: A new job with new opportunities...

games.name: Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow
games.summary: Survive the island. Build your way home.

games.name: Jigsaw Realms: Lost Isles
games.summary: Can you uncover and complete all 30 lost isles?

games.name: LumaWorlds
games.summary: LumaWorlds is a 2D multiplayer sandbox game centered on its deep item crafting system, player-driven economy, and persistent, community-built worlds. LumaWorlds blends creative freedom, social trading, and collaborative world-building.

games.name: Maid in Grisaille
games.summary: A 2D dating sim in the dark romance genre, aimed at a female audience.

games.name: Nmnmah
games.summary: A short atmospheric horror game where you play a father searching for his missing son in a quiet neighborhood haunted by a wandering entity inspired by an old Saudi legend. Explore, collect keys and notes, survive encounters, and uncover the truth as the presence stalks you through the night.

games.name: OxyRail
games.summary: OxyRail is a cooperative survival and train-building game where players manage a moving base, gather resources, explore unknown worlds, defend against threats and upgrade their train while traveling through dangerous environments.

games.name: Paper Plane
games.summary: Experience the nostalgic thrill of arcade shoot 'em ups with unique hand-drawn aesthetic. Battle endless waves of alien enemies while mastering the innovative tail-ramming mechanics and weapon overheat system. Collect powerful bonuses like shields and rapid-fire modes as you fight for survival.

games.name: Power Off
games.summary: A fully 3D first-person shooter for the Playdate! Go kick off these corrupted monstrosities from our past and future!

games.name: Project - Labyrinth
games.summary: A fantasy turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawler RPG with a blackjack-style card system that drives combat and skill execution.

games.name: Rei and the Floating City
games.summary: Rei is on a journey to become a fully-fledged mage when her airship meets a terrible fate. She and her family crash land in Jupeterno and are nursed back to health by some locals... Except apparently once someone arrives in Jupeterno, they're never allowed to leave. Add in political intrigue and a mysterious, beautiful princess, and Rei's chances of ever making it home are crashing as rapidly as her airship did! Battle through a magical tower full of monsters to get what you need to escape the country... or give in and resign yourself to your fate. Which will you choose?

games.name: Selective Memory
games.summary: A third-person psychological exploration game where you relive fragmented memories in three distorted variations: idyllic, mundane, or horrific -- before escaping the loop to make a choice that affects more than just the past.

games.name: Sonafleki
games.summary: Sonafleki plays like "Flicky" (the Genesis game), meaning that your player is slippery and bounces off of walls. Explore a massive overworld (reminiscent of "Knytt Underground");, collect new double jump types and get lost. Challenge linear levels, each with their own distinct visual style, gimmicks, and music. Play only what you want; you can experience an ending of the game by only playing easy levels and completing easy tasks. For the challengers, extra difficult content is provided.

games.name: 101 Cats in Naples
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Naples landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: Boundary Pusher
games.summary: Push your boundaries to stop the ritual

games.name: Byteworld
games.summary: Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the ultimate VR experience that aims to bring streamers and viewers together like never before!

games.name: Campfire with Cat
games.summary: Campfire with Cat is a work-focus clicker game where you maintain the campfire by working in other software. Cozy sounds relax you, while the tension of the fire going out naturally drives task concentration. Gentle interactions with the cat bring comfort and focus to your work.

games.name: Castaway Cross
games.summary: Castaway Cross is a daily logic game inspired by Survivor and Immaculate Grid. Connect players across seasons, twists, and eras using strategy, memory, and a bit of intuition. Built for fans who love the details.

games.name: Circle With a Gun
games.summary: A bullet hell roguelike where you are a force of destruction from the moment you pick up the controls. The endless hordes of Vampire Survivors meets the satisfying micro of Hades, all set to a retro arcade soundtrack that slaps harder than it has any right to.

games.name: Cursed Blight
games.summary: Cursed Blight is a short, single-player, old-school dungeon-crawling adventure steeped in unforgiving darkness.

games.name: Dash Trails
games.summary: A pixel-art 2D platformer action game where players clear stages, defeat powerful bosses, and gain new abilities. Combat shifts between drawn and sheathed weapons, offering sword attacks, punches, and kicks. Master precise defense and stylish knockback battles to overcome fierce enemies.

games.name: Deathground
games.summary: Deathground is a solo and co-op survival horror game that throws players into a desperate battle for survival against deadly AI dinosaurs.

games.name: Fooling Dead
games.summary: On April Fool's Day, the protagonist is caught in eerie supernatural events! As you investigate, uncover the truth behind a past tragedy. Explore chilling scenes, solve mysteries, and face unknown fears—can you survive?

games.name: Ignore the blackbird
games.summary:
Ignore the Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolor puzzle game set inside a beautiful greenhouse. Explore the room, interact with the objects around you, and reflect on what happened to Sonya's family as the story unfolds in a David Lynch-ish fashion.

What begins as a beautiful summer day slowly fades into somber, surreal autumn, revealing an emotional story of hope and sorrow.

games.name: Kingdom of Marionettes
games.summary:
You are a newly hired security guard assigned to watch over an abandoned puppet theater called Kingdom of Marionettes. Your duties are simple enough. keep troublemakers away, clean the theater, and make sure none of the puppets go missing or start wandering around. Wait. Wandering around? That has to be a joke.

Well... not exactly.

Because during your night shifts, the puppets are very much alive. And one of them, a mischievous jester puppet seems eager to play with you.

games.name: Kraa
games.summary:
A short atmospheric game about a murder of crows in an uncertain world.

Fly above the landscape, explore, gather all your corvid friends and find a place to rest in safety. And above all, enjoy the view.

games.name: Letter to Neml
games.summary: A story about the Noctarian, a race whose nightmares become reality. Small choices made by Neml, a girl staying home alone, shape the fate of the world. The player does only one thing: rewrite the letter sent to Neml. An AI interprets the letter, changing Neml's actions and the story's outcome.

games.name: Lost Lands: Mistakes of the Past
games.summary: In a new series of "Lost Lands" Susan has to go to the past to try and correct other people's mistakes. Will she succeed? What problems will she face there? All this can be learned by sinking into the new series of "Lost Lands: Mistakes of the Past".

games.name: Mr Farmboy
games.summary: MR FARMBOY is a cute colony farming automation game. Plant, grow, harvest, raise animals, hire workers, gather, craft, automate, and build a beautiful farm for villagers to visit.

games.name: Nekopara Love Project Vol. 4
games.summary:
NEKOPARA, the popular visual novel series that has sold over 6.5 million copies worldwide, now has a remake version for smartphones!

With enhanced graphics, fresh recordings from a new cast of voice actors, and exclusive episodes, this powered-up remake is ready for Masters all around the world!

games.name: Pokémon Consonancia
games.summary: Pokémon Consonance, inspired by Pokémon Masters, is a game in which you will travel to Passio as a novice trainer, there you will meet different characters from all the official releases together, from Kanto to Paldea, as well as characters brought by the Masters, such as Professor Margarita, You will participate in the WPM, a high level tournament that seeks to determine the strongest trainer of all, to achieve this task, you must improve as a trainer, but also, you must recruit different characters for your team, some of them will do it by history but many of them will depend on a RNG factor: The gachapon mode. It won't be easy to be the best, so testing strategies and team combinations will be fundamental!

games.name: Qualial Nature
games.summary: 『Qualial Nature』 is a gentle exploration experience where you purify the forest while connecting with nature. Players visit the forest and encounter Anima of land, sea, and sky. Borrowing the power of the Anima, solve nature's troubles one by one and gradually guide the forest back to its true form.

games.name: RC Overdrive
games.summary: Dive into the exciting world of remote-controlled car racing with RC Overdrive, where strategy, precision, and speed come together for an electrifying and thrilling experience!

games.name: Sector Ninja
games.summary: Sector Ninja is a stealth action game where you play as a ninja assassin moving through enemy controlled sectors with only a katana. To advance, you must clear every sector by eliminating all hostile ninjas across 2-3 stages. Enemies patrol with blades and weapons, and once they spot you, survival becomes much harder. Stay out of sight, approach carefully, and strike first with silent takedowns. Defeated enemies drop money that can be used to unlock new skins. As you progress, sectors become harder and require better timing and stealth.

games.name: Sheep & Love
games.summary:
A queer visual novel with hand-embroidered backgrounds !

You move in la Vallée d'Ossau in the French Pyrénées with your best friend. Your goal: raise cute sheep and sell their wool on markets !

You meet the locals and are surprised to see that they're all: super nice, great musicians and... find you to be the most fascinating person in the Valley.

Which single are you goind to get closer to ?

games.name: Simply Moose
games.summary: Reflex-based puzzle game based on Boulder Dash principles, but with its own unique style.

games.name: Who Wants to Be an Ultimate? Retake
games.summary: "Who Wants to Be an Ultimate? -retake-" is a free to play one-shot Danganronpa fangame created in RPG Maker MV.

games.name: Wizards & Summons
games.summary: Among wizards, various things come into vogue and then fade away. "Wizards & Summons" is one of them. An orthodox single-player card game with simple controls! There are over 400 types of cards available!

games.name: Aether Hexxen: Death-Space Requiem Act1
games.summary: A futuristic visual novel filled with mature romance, humor, strategy, drama, & more. A space-opera adventure filled with developing relationships with a diverse cast of motivated, personable characters. Save humanity & friendly aliens from servitude or extinction out in the stars.

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Beer Clicker
games.summary: Beer Clicker is a casual idle clicker game where you brew beer, earn bottles, and expand your brewery. Click to produce, unlock upgrades, automate systems, and enjoy satisfying progression at your own pace.

games.name: Blooming Ashes
games.summary:
This game is a course project that we're excited to launch and experiment with in the Steam world. We're telling a story with great enthusiasm and hope that it reaches many people who can appreciate the world in which it unfolds. The game is based in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a pandemic called Lavender, which infects simply by breathing it. The story takes place two years after the pandemic's outbreak. It's a graphic novel with decision-making, in which you'll play as Char, one of the main characters. It's a relatively short experience that introduces the entire world of Lavender.

In short, the game is a graphic novel with constant decision-making. Depending on the choices you make, the course of the story can change, leading to several endings in this first chapter.

games.name: Colorado Rail Game
games.summary: Experience Colorado by rail in this relaxing travel simulation. Manage your inventory and hunger as you journey across the plains, collecting rare souvenirs and local lore. Meet a cast of diverse passengers to uncover the authentic history and culture of the Centennial State.

games.name: Competitive TicTacToe
games.summary: Revolutionize the classic game. In this fast-paced strategy title, your oldest piece disappears once the board is full. No draws, just deep tactical gameplay. Think ahead, trap your opponent, and climb the global ELO leaderboards in a battle where every move counts.

games.name: Coney's
games.summary: Coney's is a 1 or 2 player online co-op game where you work at an ice cream parlor that specializes in cones! Bake cones! Scoop ice cream! Serve with a smile! And at the end of your shift, don’t forget to clean up the store before you head home! Nothing bad will happen!

games.name: Detectives United: Vengeance from the Past - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Can your all-star detective team crack the case in time?

games.name: Escape Up
games.summary: Escape Up if you can. Climb the tower and defeat the monsters as you try to escape. Killing all the monsters in a room will unlock the next room. Challenge others climbers on the leaderboards and see how fast you can manage to escape. Ready, set, climb!

games.name: GetHigh.exe
games.summary: GetHigh.EXE is a first-person parkour platformer. Experience about 350 meters of vertical climbing with precise movement, challenging jumps, moving platforms, and rotating obstacles. GetHigh supports keyboard & mouse and controller.

games.name: Halloween Filled With Cats
games.summary: Purrfectly Spooky Halloween awaits you! Dive into hand-drawn Halloween scene filled with cute, sneaky cats hiding in every corner. Relax, explore whimsical illustration, enjoy subtle animations, and see how many feline friends you can find in this cozy hidden object adventure.

games.name: Hole Your Horses: Champion Edition
games.summary: A comedic arcade-action game which purports to be a simulation of dressage (competitive horse gymnastics) but mainly involves tossing a flailing horse ragdoll through a hole in a swiftly approaching wall, “Human Tetris”-style. Complete challenges to unlock additional horses and uncover more of this strange horse-oriented world.

games.name: Konfronto
games.summary: Sci-fi roguelike auto battler where you command an intergalactic carrier, outfitting it with new spacecraft and technologies to take on other players in asynchronous multiplayer

games.name: LOZT: Legion of Zombie Terrors
games.summary: A military experiment has turned all of the troops into ZOMBIES... With weapons!

games.name: Mainframe Men
games.summary: Learn about the ancestors of the very computer that you're looking at this now with in this interactive visual novel. ENIAC, UNIVAC... Wait, are these machines talking to you?

games.name: Masks of the Void: Origins
games.summary: Masks of the Void is a Rogue-lite action-RPG where you use powerful masks that grant you unique powers. Player's can level up their skills and swap them out for better ones as their journey continues.

games.name: Miya Might Break
games.summary: A psychological horror visual novel about Miya, a former prodigy trapped in a decaying home with her unstable stepfather, her talking plush Mopa, and the bystander who hears every step she takes. Walk the ritual loops, and decide who survives Miya’s breaking point across three unsettling endings.

games.name: Polygon War
games.summary: A 2D comic-style squad survival game. Command triangle, square, and pentagon characters through waves of increasing difficulty. Mount weapons on every edge — blades, guns, flamethrowers, and more. Stack same weapons for gear combo bonuses. Burn, freeze, or shatter foes using material weaknesses.

games.name: Rainbow Six Mobile
games.summary: From the acclaimed Rainbow Six franchise, Rainbow Six Mobile is a competitive, multiplayer first-person shooter experience on your phone. Compete in Rainbow Six's classic Attack vs. Defense game modes. Play as an Attacker or Defender in fast-paced 5v5 matches and face intense close-quarter combat while making timely tactical decisions. Choose from a roster of highly trained Operators, each with their own unique abilities and gadgets. Experience this ultimate tactical shooter game, designed exclusively for mobile.

games.name: Royal Vermin
games.summary: Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

games.name: Second Humanity
games.summary: On the surface, Second Humanity seems like the ultimate school drama in a prestigious Colombian academy. As the new student in Class 02, you are surrounded by prodigies: the conciliatory Eva, the provocative Caelum, and the spectral Isoria. But beneath the marble walls of Humanity School lies a dystopia where survival depends on your ability to exploit the weaknesses of others—or perhaps, finally understand who 'They' truly are.

games.name: Slither Realm
games.summary: Help the snakes rest without disturbing each other by filling up the available space! Use your analytical skills to solve the puzzle and guide the snakes to their perfect resting spots.

games.name: Spider Roulette
games.summary: Spider Roulette is a tense online party game where 2-4 friends take turns flipping cups, trying to avoid finding each other's spiders..

games.name: StarDrift Delivery
games.summary: Smuggle your way to freedom in this fast-paced space delivery action roguelite where you are in debt to the mob. Blast through asteroids for speed, weave through chaos, and deliver packages to survive. Don't let the debt consume you.

games.name: SuperNova
games.summary: A space-themed Suika game where you combine planets to create even bigger ones!

games.name: Tashio Tempo
games.summary: Explore a world filled with corrupted creatures. Focus your mind to cast spells that affect the environment. Wear different tunics for their magical effects, and master playing the Lute in this top-down Game Boy inspired adventure.

games.name: Territory Control 2
games.summary: A 2D multiplayer sandbox game revolving around industry, innovation, factions, combat and emergent gameplay. Design factories, customize tools and weapons, fight or trade with other players or get viciously murdered by an angry badger.

games.name: The Tall Man Tapes
games.summary: The Tall Man Tapes is a found footage inspired horror game. You're a UFO investigator trying to get to the bottom of a mystery. Will you learn the truth and escape with your life?

games.name: Tight Man
games.summary: Tight Man is a fast-paced action roguelike where you use your own head as an explosive weapon. Explore dangerous dungeons, collect grotesque power-ups, and master the self-detonation mechanics to defeat hordes of enemies in this chaotic pixel-art shooter.

games.name: Unchi
games.summary: A casual roguelite runner where a kid hero fights to save his hamster who pooped itself to death. Play as Ram in a 2d side-scroller, unlocking suits, powers, and cards in a fast, absurd journey to rescue Unchi.

games.name: Unknown Terminal
games.summary: Retro terminal mystery: explore a live IBM PS/2, decode corrupted logs, and learn who waits behind the blinking prompt.

games.name: You Are the Bomb: A Game About Rolling Bombs
games.summary: Collect coins, gems and gun powder, uncover secrets, and conquer epic bosses across time-based levels. Test your skills by mastering the rolling mechanics in this action-packed 3D platformer! Face dynamic environments, harness powerful abilities, and race to save the magical world of Boomerland!

games.name: A Game About Ramen
games.summary: A Game About Ramen is cozy little game puts you behind the counter of a humble ramen shop. You’ll serve steaming bowls to hungry customers, experiment with ingredients, and keep the shop running late into the night.

games.name: AstroDX
games.summary: AstroDX (Formerly MaipadDX) is a mobile maimai simulator intended for those who do not yet have access to a cabinet, those who want to practice, and everyone interested in maimai who otherwise could not play the arcade game.

games.name: Blueman
games.summary:
After King Bedrieger commands his loyal warrior, Blueman, to find an ancient artifact, Blueman finds himself in a treacherous temple full of traps, monsters, and hidden treasures.

Blueman is a platformer game with bite sized levels, a strict time limit, and collectables to increase your score. Points are important beyond just getting a high score- earning points grants you more health! The order of the stages is randomized, and you only have to finish 5 levels to get to the next world. For experienced explorers, an optional "Gauntlet mode" has you play every single last level.

games.name: Bread & Fred
games.summary: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.name: Capy Spa
games.summary: In Capy Spa, you help Pipa, a relaxation-loving capybara, push herb buckets into hot springs to prepare the perfect bath.

games.name: Coin Slots Live
games.summary: Interactive slots gameplay built for live streaming. Connect your Twitch channel and let your chat spin, earn, and participate in real time. Currently supports Twitch, with YouTube and Kick on the way. Participate in the game outcome during Early Access!

games.name: Crimson Loop
games.summary: Fight your way through waves of increasingly frenzied hordes of monsters! Earning upgrades, powerups, and abilities. All in a mysterious yet satisfying adventure! To uncover the mysterious story behind your origins, The Loop, and much more.

games.name: Dark México
games.summary: This is a focused and intense soulslike, built around a single monumental confrontation where every mistake is costly and every victory is earned through pure skill.

games.name: Doom
games.summary:
The new. The improved. The definitive Doom SNES experience!

All 4 Doom episodes, including Thy Flesh Consumed, added circle-strafe, Performance improvements, Monster respawning on Nightmare difficulty, Level codes, and Rumble support via an all-new controller!

Welcome to Doom, soldier. Now shut up and start fighting because there's no time to waste! We're talking total war against the forces of evil, with the only thing standing between civilization and the end of everything as we know it is you - one angry Marine with a handgun and a bad attitude. This is the full-auto, 16-meg faithful version of the PC original. Which means all the same monsters, levels, weapons, and surprises are around for a screaming fast descent into danger with sudden death lurking around every corner. Strap on your ammo and prepare to spit lead. Because now's your chance to be a hero.

games.name: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator
games.summary: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator throws you into the fast-paced world of a high-poly, first-person drive-thru restaurant, where you are both a worker and the manager. From prepping ingredients to handing out orders through the service window, every task is in your hands. Can you serve every customer quickly, keep the kitchen running smoothly, and turn your restaurant into the city’s favorite spot?

games.name: Emberbane
games.summary: Emberbane is a pixel action-platformer with combat revolving around a mixture of four elements with unique abilities. Join Ophelia on her journey to slay the malevolent gods of elements and bring equilibrium to the land; use the elementals to your advantage and uncover the untold tale of centuries.

games.name: Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition
games.summary: The base game, six official add-ons, and over 150 pieces of Creation Club content get bundled together in one neat package in celebration of Fallout 4’s 10th anniversary.

games.name: Fields of Mine
games.summary: Fields of Mine is a roguelike puzzle where classic Minesweeper turns into an unpredictable adventure. Each level changes the rules, challenging your logic, focus, and adaptability.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII
games.summary: The 2012 release of Final Fantasy VII made its way to consoles with new Speed-Up, Battle Enhancement, and No Encounter features. It was later brought to PC.

games.name: G Press
games.summary:
G Press is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control a press that is constantly moving up and down. Your goal is to catch the rising bubbles and keep the liquid below from evaporating. Press a button to press the bubbles and turn them back into liquid.

The game is over when the liquid at the bottom runs out.

games.name: Hexa Merge
games.summary: Hexa Merge is a captivating puzzle game that combines strategic thinking with satisfying merge mechanics on a unique hexagonal grid. Match and merge tiles to unlock beautiful new tile designs and reach higher levels!

games.name: Insect
games.summary: A bitter BULLET HELL SHOOTER...

games.name: Iverian Wars: Craxion vs Defugel
games.summary: Iverian Wars: Craxion vs Defugel is a faction-based strategic action MMORPG set in the world of Iveria. Engage in large-scale battles, customize your gear freely, and shape the fate of the continent through war and strategy.

games.name: Journey of Johann: Castle Crusade
games.summary:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.

games.name: Labsylle
games.summary: A cool word puzzle game, all about the "building blocks" of the English language.

games.name: Last Mage
games.summary: Tailor your perfect backpack in the roguelite, spell-based, bullet heaven game. Explore further into the dungeons, weave spells, find magical artifacts and craft new ones. Do everything to survive and keep the flame of magic burning, in a world that seeks to snuff it out.

games.name: Love and Hate
games.summary: Each Hallow's Eve, the lost souls that haunt the cemetery surrounding a small-town parish emerge from their slumber to torment the land and each Hallow's Eve, that parish's dedicated priest must roll up his sleeves and fend them off.

games.name: Meteorite Fall
games.summary: Let's use existence and freedom as stakes, block everything, and explore the ancient legends of the Fallen Star Village, digging out the truth buried in the long river of history.

games.name: Minus Nine
games.summary: Secure the vaccine and escape the infested facility! Battle your way from B9 to the surface rescue chopper in this isometric roguelite shooter. Restore power, upgrade your gear with Bio-Samples, and protect humanity's last hope against endless waves of the infected.

games.name: Nash Racing Pursuit 2
games.summary: Kevin Nash famous criminal and car driver is back. 11 tracks to find money piles under limited time and avoid police cars

games.name: Novel Haven
games.summary: Novel Haven is a short game based on the bestselling book series. Move to a coastal town, renovate the crumbling lighthouse and turn it into a cozy bookstore, designed entirely to your taste. Help the villagers with quests, uncover hidden secrets, and create a literary sanctuary.

games.name: Out of Time
games.summary: 10th Triennial of Polish Graphic Art main exhibition selection. Out of Time: a meditative VR journey in UE5. Beyond pure relaxation, it is a space for intimate catharsis through light and sound. A digital sanctuary for deep existential exploration. Wishlist to support independent VR art.

games.name: Piña Rollada
games.summary:
Roll your way through paradise! Piña Rollada is a top-down puzzle platformer (Monkey Ball-like) with the goal of collecting all the fruit and making it to the end of the level as fast as possible.

Can you collect all the fruit and see what secrets you might unlock?

games.name: Retro Gunner
games.summary:
A retro-style shoot 'em up created with the fantasy console “TIC-80”.

Choose your favorite craft from 4 player characters and 2 bomb types,

and conquer all 5 stages (totaling 15 areas)!

Features ARCADE mode, TEAMPLAY mode and BOSSRUSH mode.

games.name: Rise of Piracy
games.summary: The perfect blend of Action, Adventure and RTS. Begin your journey as the lowly captain of a small vessel. End as the commander of a threatening fleet. Rise to glory how you see fit. Trade, fight, recruit, grow, pillage, ally, destroy & conquer.

games.name: Rushfall
games.summary: You are the king defending your kingdom from waves of slugs! Use swords, knives, and magical powers like lightning and a magic staff to protect your land. Upgrade wisely to survive!

games.name: Scattered Wings
games.summary:
You're driving home.

It's been a long time.

Too bad the mountain is on fire.

games.name: Soapy Tales
games.summary: What if your story started in the afterlife?

games.name: Urban Heat
games.summary: Crew up and conquer the war for power on the streets in Urban Heat! Immerse yourself in the gritty, action-packed urban warzone of this epic multiplayer first-person shooter (FPS) game!

games.name: Whippet At Large
games.summary: Your owner has abandoned you yet again for something she calls a “job.” You must find her quickly before the lack of attention becomes fatal.

games.name: Wriggle Apple
games.summary: Help the worm reach the apple! Navigate through tricky paths, avoid spikes, and use stones to climb higher. Each apple makes the worm bigger, but it may cause challenges. Can you help him?

games.name: Age of Memology
games.summary: Lead an army of the internet's most recognizable memes in crazy turn-based tactics! Assemble a squad of Slappy, Doge, Gigachade and Banana Cat to clear waves of enemies, upgrade their abilities and reach the final boss of memology. It's time to find out whose meme is stronger!

games.name: Alpaca Party: Grab & Run
games.summary: Grab & Run | Alpaca Party is a physics-based multiplayer VR extraction adventure! The maps reshape every time, every object has real weight, and monsters are always watching. Team up with friends, embrace the chaos, and execute the perfect heist—or fail hilariously trying.

games.name: Asteroid 69
games.summary: Rogue asteroids have been detected heading toward earth. You are the pilot of experimental spacecrafts to destroy the impending danger. Fight solo or up to 4 players. Outerspace is full of lethal rocks and strange creatures out to stop you. Don't let your planet down!

games.name: Backrooms Stories
games.summary: Read five horror stories set in the Backrooms. Experience existential horror and terrifying encounters while making choices that will alter your fate. Will you escape or be lost forever?

games.name: Balatro
games.summary: Balatro is a deck-building roguelite in which players construct poker hands to earn chips and overcome enemy blinds. The game features mechanics for enhancing a deck of playing cards, purchasing Jokers that modify hand effects, and discovering synergies to progress through increasingly challenging encounters.

games.name: Bunny’s Rent-a-Mom Agency
games.summary: Left alone for the summer, motherless Ayato ends up with more “moms” than he ever dreamed! When Bunny’s sends doting older ladies in place of regular maids, his quiet break becomes a heartwarmingly chaotic season of head rubs, hugs—and a whole lot of healing.

games.name: Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate
games.summary:
In a world where pets run the government, President DJ Nibbles has spent most of his time lying in sunbeams and using his desk as a scratching post. But now his days of zoomies in the Oval Office are coming to a close, as the U.S. prepares to elect its next Cat President!

Six wildly incompetent candidates are throwing their yarn balls into the ring, each more dysfunctional than the last. You’re the human campaign manager tasked with keeping these adorable candidates out of trouble. Wrangle egos, dodge scandals, fall in love, and maybe even save the country...or make it much, much worse.

With a script that’s nearly 100,000 words long, Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate is a visual novel packed full of romance, humor and cute pictures of real cats. Whether you’re a campaign veteran or just here for the musical numbers and fur-flying debates, it’s the most paws-itively absurd political simulator you’ll ever play.

games.name: Chess of Mana
games.summary: Now Celts and Orcs face off in a chess battle where fallen warriors can be revived by the Mana of the Kings! Choose your side of the battlefield—uh, we mean the board—plot the best strategy, use your mana, and defeat the enemy to claim glory!

games.name: Climb Driver
games.summary: Race through challenging levels as you collect coins, jump obstacles, and perform flips to reach the finish line.

games.name: Cocommando
games.summary: The humorous adventures of a little rooster who must rescue his beloved and friends kidnapped by a gang of foxes. Fast-paced action in colorful 3D worlds. Various settings and worlds, funny weapons and challenging tasks. Up to 25 main levels plus extras! Cocommando needs your help — let's go!

games.name: Date Night
games.summary: A short game about trying to impress someone you just met at a bar. Try to keep the conversation going... or don't. Do whatever feels right for you.

games.name: Deep Space Shooter
games.summary: Again you are alone against the hordes of hostile spacecrafts where you can only rely on yourself. It is the victory or the death!

games.name: Dice A Million
games.summary: Have you ever tried rolling 1,000,000 points on some dice? No? Well, now at least you can try.

games.name: Discolored
games.summary: Discolored is a first-person puzzle adventure game where all the colors have gone missing. It's up to you to bring them back.

games.name: Eggconsole: Hydlide 3 - PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary:
The concluding chapter of the Hydlide series. Can you, as an adventurer, once again save Fairyland? This is the third installment in the iconic Japanese action RPG series, "Hydlide." and the player once again rises to the occasion to save Fairyland from a new crisis.

In addition to the graphics and sound inherited from the previous title as a sequel to the series, this ambitious work incorporates a moderate amount of various elements, such as the ability to choose a class, the concept of time, the need to eat during adventures, and the need to manage luggage due to the weight of items to be carried.

It can be said that this game title not only appealed to fans of the Hydlide series but also left a lasting impression on numerous gaming enthusiasts.

games.name: Exit Lab 15 Rooms
games.summary: Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Challenge countless room escapes and aim for that Master rank!

games.name: Fall of an Empire
games.summary: Defend your realm from invaders in Fall of an Empire. Barbarians attack your frontiers and treacherous vassals plot against you. You know your crumbling empire won't last forever, but it's up to you to see how long you can save it.

games.name: Food Store Simulator
games.summary: Run your own food store! Buy products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your shop into a bigger business.

games.name: FoxWolf Saga
games.summary: FoxWolf Saga is a 2D platformer where players alternate control between two contrasting heroes: a nimble Fox and a powerful Wolf. The Wolf can perform a devastating dash that destroys enemies and obstacles while granting brief invincibility, while the Fox uses agility and a double jump to reach areas the Wolf cannot.

games.name: Honest Helper
games.summary: Honest Helper is a top-down strategy game where you use time manipulation to defeat all enemies without any casualties. This cute and charming game will challenge your tactical and decision making skills for hours on end.

games.name: Honey Bunny
games.summary: Honey Bunny is a bartender at Lucky Rabbit's Foot Casino, the cutest casino in all of Starlight City! She's busy at work when the no-good gang, The Cool Cats, steals away the casino and the entire city's supply of cocktail cherries. Chase them down as Honey Bunny using your ears to headbutt enemies, grab items, and platform around the city as you recover as many cherries as possible!

games.name: ISO/2004
games.summary: A Filipino psychological horror experience where a photographer’s camera reveals what his mind refuses to remember. As hauntings intensify, an unresolved case resurfaces and exposing denial, guilt, and a love that never left.

games.name: Infinite Bowling
games.summary: This is an infinite bowling lane with one objective, get a new Highscore.

games.name: Knightfall Showdown
games.summary: Step into the ultimate chess rumble! In Knightfall Showdown, 100 players face off on a massive board, upgrading pieces and outsmarting opponents in intense elimination rounds. Strategize, rise through the ranks, and become the last piece standing!

games.name: Lawnmower Game Beer
games.summary: Lawnmower simulation game where mission is to collect and find 10 beer bottles under limited time to finish game. Need also avoid bombs and zombies

games.name: Lovejuiced!: Hi Neighbor, meet Gamer
games.summary: Keita’s summer kicks off with a random game chat—just anonymous “bros” trading jokes and awkward confessions. But when he learns his whole party is actually a group of girls living next door, things spiral fast in a season of neighborly chaos, college camaraderie, and maybe... something more.

games.name: Medieval Escape 2
games.summary: Medieval Escape 2 is a third-person adventure game. The protagonist is a young woman trapped in an ancient medieval labyrinth. To survive, she must avoid deadly traps and find a way out. There is no combat—only cleverness, observation, and quick reflexes. Every corner of the maze hides danger, and every step could mean the difference between life and death.

games.name: Megaquarium: Invertebrilliant Collection
games.summary: Cascading coral displays, weird and wonderful critters and game-changing new tank designs make the Invertebrilliant Collection a must-have for Megaquarium enthusiasts!

games.name: Mini Warrior Defense
games.summary: Lead your warriors on an epic adventure to defend your kingdom from invaders - in this action tower defense game, you can use various defense towers, levels, heroes, and many good things to help you destroy enemies!

games.name: Movie Business: Die Welt der Filme
games.summary:
This game, still in beta, plunges you into the exciting world of the movie industry. You take on the role of a producer or director and manage the entire production process – from brainstorming and casting to marketing. You'll need to manage your finances wisely, cultivate talent, and react to trends to make your film a huge success.

The game is ideal for anyone looking for a glimpse into the complex world of film production – without dry theory, but with a healthy dose of strategy and fun. In the beta, you can already try out different genres and compete against other players, while the development team continuously adds new features.

Whether you're a film buff or simply enjoy virtual challenges, this movie business game combines creativity with management and delivers thrilling entertainment.

games.name: Nested Lands
games.summary: A ruthless settlement-survival RPG in a post-plague medieval world full of cruelty and despair. Gather survivors, build a settlement, craft, master your skills, survive, and endure alone or in online co-op.

games.name: Olber's Paradox
games.summary: Olber’s Paradox is a fast paced side scrolling arcade game set in space. Control a living plasma sphere, destroy glowing enemies, discover hidden power ups, and face a boss after every level.

games.name: Paper Craft
games.summary: A VR platformer that takes place in a world of arts and crafts! Run, swing, ride, hover, and platform your way through 20 campaign levels. Create and share your own levels worldwide with our easy to use level editor!

games.name: Pirate Simulator: Corsair Skull & Sails
games.summary: Raise the sails and prepare to explore a world full of dangers and opportunities in Pirate Simulator - Corsair Skull & Sails! Step into the shoes of of Sebastian Roco and embark on a legendary adventure across endless seas. Explore tropical islands, conquer enemy ships, and uncover hidden treasures that could change the fate of the world.

games.name: Pizza Panic!
games.summary: Pizza Panic! Is a 1-4-player co-op cooking game where you and your friends try to keep your pizza parlor running for as long as possible. Work together, bake pizzas, earn money, buy upgrades and ensure you have the greatest pizza parlor of all time!

games.name: Pogui
games.summary: Pogui is a short and charming platformer about a dreamy pug trapped in a nightmare. Travel through 5 worlds filled with creative levels, dozens of different enemies and unique mechanics to help Pogui wake up, if he can escape the entity that imprisoned him in his own dream!

games.name: Project: Colt
games.summary: Project: Colt is an action game where players take control of a skilled gunslinger navigating dangerous environments and confronting hostile enemies. Using fast reflexes and strategic abilities, the player must survive encounters, overcome challenges, and uncover the mysteries behind the world around them.

games.name: Raiden Fighters 2 Remix
games.summary: The legendary Seibu Kaihatsu arcade game Raiden Fighters 2 returns, revived from the depths of time.

games.name: Raiden Fighters Jet Remix

games.name: Railroad Corporation 2
games.summary: Railroad Corporation 2 is a train tycoon game set at the turn of the 20th century, where you take on the mantle of a railroad magnate to start your new railroad corporation. Seize the opportunity of railroad electrification to lead the charge in the new era of trains. Strategize as you lay tracks, balance finances, deploy locomotives to ferry goods across vast landscapes, and outpace the competition.

games.name: Reigns: The Witcher
games.summary: Adventure as Geralt through the ballads of Dandelion. Swipe right, swipe left, seek glory, find death! Will you hunt monsters, upset the locals, or run a hot bath? Compose an inspiring epic to claim immortality.

games.name: Revenger: Origin
games.summary: The retro RPG from the feature phone era, the Revenge Series, is back!

games.name: SkillGrid
games.summary: SkillGrid is a minimalist strategy game where you expand, manage, and defend a growing grid against an evolving hostile force.

games.name: Sokocat: Castaway
games.summary: Sokocat: Castaway is a 3D Sokoban-style puzzle game with an isometric view, where you control a shipwrecked kitty exploring a mysterious island full of secrets, varied environments, and relaxing brain teasers. No danger, no rush — just clever puzzles and peaceful exploration.

games.name: Stacked!
games.summary: A pleasant evening to relax - but not here. Get dressed, fix your hair, and strike a winning pose. Try building a tower out of your small figurines alone, or gather up to 4 players. A lucky figurine can lead to victory - or defeat.

games.name: Stirge Hunters
games.summary: An experimental indie MMORPG focused on a frontier survival roleplaying scenario.

games.name: Stringate
games.summary: Stringate is a level-based puzzle game with portals and other complex mechanics.

games.name: Survive the Spin
games.summary: A lone hero faces creatures invading the kingdom on a deadly spinning wheel. Jump on enemies to survive, clear increasingly challenging levels, and enjoy catchy melodies in an arcade adventure with infinite retries.

games.name: The Deluge
games.summary:
"The forest seemed like a fairy tale when you were little, one where you might wander down the trail and never return. In truth, it only stretches a few acres to what used to be an outlying subdivision. Now, though, it might fulfill its old potential. An adventurer could wade, then swim, then find an entire realm under the still and clouded water.

Do you still believe that?"

A hypertext exploration game about the physical and emotional landscape of your flooding hometown and your attempts to get the hell out.

games.name: They Killed Your Cat
games.summary: A short but relentless first-person shooter featuring manual reloading, walking, and blinking, with settings that let you customize your experience.

games.name: Trix
games.summary: TRIX is a high-speed arcade cycling game focused on risk and precision. Perform aerial tricks, and build massive scores while speed keeps rising. Perfect for quick sessions and score chasing.

games.name: Ufophilia
games.summary: UFOPHILIA is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore areas marked by alien phenomena. Use specialized equipment to detect, identify, and photograph aliens—but do so at your own risk... They are watching you too.

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: Utawarerumono: ZAN 2
games.summary: Utawarerumono: ZAN 2 is a 3D Action RPG playstyle based on Utawarerumono: The Mask of Deception. Introducing new scenarios, the main story, "Hakuoro Arena," is based on Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth and told in a "military chronicle" style. You can play either solo or coop (up to four players online). This mode features exclusive enemies, maps, and more.

games.name: Vvintercore
games.summary: A visual psychological horror novel set in a winter setting. You have a unique opportunity to explore your relationships with your friends, and then with yourself. But be careful, a blizzard seems to be approaching.

games.name: Wikigacha
games.summary: A card-collecting game featuring over 6,000,000 random Wikipedia articles that you can collect and battle with. Higher quality articles become higher rarity cards.

games.name: Within of Static: Northgate Mall
games.summary: You play as Dylan Miller, a night security guard assigned to watch over the nearly abandoned Northgate Mall. What starts as a quiet shift of cameras and radio calls slowly turns into a night where something inside the mall doesn’t want to stay hidden.

games.name: Zàijiàn Duàn Dāo
games.summary: The ancient-style suspense and reasoning AVG "Goodbye, Broken Blade" - In an isolated mountain villa, a series of terrifying murders occur one after another. Only through meticulous investigation and meticulous reasoning can a clear right and wrong be determined and justice be restored. However, beneath the truth that is gradually surfacing, there seem to be undercurrents at play

games.name: 101 Cats in Vancouver
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Vancouver landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: Afterplace
games.summary:
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woods, fight monsters, and talk to ostensibly shady characters! All from your pocket! Be warned though - you never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.

Afterplace has been designed from the ground up to be a fast, fluid, beautiful experience for mobile. There are no virtual buttons. You can move and attack by touching anywhere. You can tap objects directly to interact or attack, or use two thumbs like a traditional controller. The game will adapt dynamically to your play style. Pick up and set down the game at your own pace, it will always save your progress. Afterplace is made to feel like a full-fledged indie adventure game that fits in your pocket.

games.name: Amy Hates Robots
games.summary: AI has possessed everything. Toasters, telephones, and trash cans have come alive and want you dead. Fight back with a bizarre array of weapons, from bouncy balls to banana guns. Battle through deadly arenas and make strange allies in this action roguelike, as you uncover an apocalyptic conspiracy.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Rave Racer
games.summary:
"Rave Racer" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
With dynamic presentation and more exhilarating drift control, this title evolved in every way, becoming a hit that soared past the high expectations set for the third installment in the RIDGE RACER series. The diverse soundtrack further pumps up the race, igniting a frenzy that truly lives up to its name—RAVE!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Rave Racer

games.name: Bloodmatch
games.summary: The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…

games.name: Cats Ritual
games.summary: Lights out - cats out! Catch them before it's too late!

games.name: City Hunter
games.summary:
Released on March 2, 1990 as the only official home-console game of its kind, this legendary title returns 35 years later—now launching worldwide simultaneously with all the excitement of its original debut.

This game is more than just a remake—it’s a fusion of nostalgia and newness. With multi-language localization, both long-time fans and new players can enjoy the experience without a language barrier.

Relive the excitement and emotional moments once more.

games.name: Codename: Twilight
games.summary: The treacherous world of Cyber Neon and Data Mist, with the core gameplay of puzzle solving, deduction and parkour. Single-player or multi-player play as a time and space hacker, collect the subtle evidence scattered everywhere, to reveal the unknown shocking truth.

games.name: Color Mismatch Brain Quiz
games.summary:
Simple brain training: spot the mismatch between color and words.
Top shows the color, bottom shows the word.

games.name: Cordel Lands
games.summary: Face the legends of Cordel (Brazilian folklore) in an intense, top-down Action Roguelite. In a mystical land brought to life by a unique 2.5D woodcut art style, you'll need to master visceral Hack-and-Slash combat to survive waves of enemies and unveil the dark secrets that haunt these lands.

games.name: Corner Kitchen Fast Food Simulator
games.summary: Buy cooking equipment, prepare delicious meals, and serve hungry customers. Upgrade your setup, read customer reviews, and expand your business to become the top fast-food joint in the city.

games.name: Crazy Basket
games.summary: Crazy Basket hurls you onto a wild street court where physics, timing, and a bit of chaos rule every shot.

games.name: Cyber Farmer
games.summary: Cyber Farmer is a crazy farming simulator where old meets new! Take over your grandpa Kazimierz's farm in a post-apocalyptic world, using cyber tech, modified plants, and even cyber pigs. It’s full of laughs, weird surprises, and quirky farming fun. Farm the future, laugh through the past!

games.name: Daisenryaku SSB2
games.summary: Wield over 300 modern weapons, from jets to tanks, and outmaneuver rival forces with your strategy. From small islands to massive total-war maps, turn-based battles let both newcomers and veterans play at their own pace.

games.name: Diving Into Abyss
games.summary: You are a new recruit in a professional civilian diving rescue team. Your first mission is to rescue the missing cave diver.

games.name: Dream Team Supreme
games.summary: Pilot a giant robot against a horde of monsters in this co-op roguelike deckbuilder. Attempt each proc-gen run alone or with a friend. Draw from and build up 2 decks at the same time, plan the sequence of each turn, and plug in the best mods. You'll need a big brain, or two, to prevent the invasion!

games.name: Dungeon Armory
games.summary: Craft your own weapons, explore dungeons, and progress. Prove your skills in the capital's competitions and defeat the monsters of the prophecy. A medieval fantasy RPG with crafting elements that combines blacksmith simulation with action-packed dungeon crawling.

games.name: Eggconsole Super Cooks MSX2
games.summary: Inheriting the gameplay of 'Shin Maou Golvellius' but set in a unique world. Now, time to embark on your culinary quest!?

games.name: Emoji Battlefield: Island Warfare
games.summary: Fast-paced rogue-like FPS mayhem on a mysterious island!

games.name: Exit Lab Expert Level
