Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Challenge advanced escape rooms
and aim for that Master rank!

games.name: Exit Lab Intermediate Level
games.summary: Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Take on intermediate escape challenges and level up your Exit Skill!

games.name: Fixer Undercover
games.summary: Welcome to DIY Espionage - a VR puzzle adventure where everyday tools and found objects become your problem-solving kit. Go undercover as a repair worker inside a prison, investigate a mysterious rehabilitation program through various challenges, and make your escape with the truth.

games.name: Forgotten Possessions
games.summary: In Forgotten Possessions, you play as a lost soul trapped in a forest cabin. You must retrieve cursed relics and deposit them into a ritual container to unlock your escape, all while being hunted by a auditory-sensitive creature.

games.name: GOT3D
games.summary: A faithful 3D action-adventure remake of the classic 1994 DOS shareware title 'God of Thunder' built in the Godot engine. Players traverse the land of Midgard as Thor, solving puzzles, talking to wacky townspeople, and using the mythical hammer Mjolnir to defeat the evil serpent Jormangund.

games.name: Gas Station Manager 2026
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a station manager and take over an abandoned roadside gas station. From rusty pumps and empty shelves to a bustling hub of activity, every decision is yours. Refuel cars, clean vehicles, manage the store, and maintain the area — success depends on your skill, speed, and strategy. Experience the challenge of running a full-service station, where every role matters and every customer counts.

games.name: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo
games.summary: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo is a discouraging game about climbing a surreal mountain with a golf ball, a different take on 2017's hit Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy. Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge.

games.name: Guilds of Greybrook
games.summary: Guilds of Greybrook is a roguelike management simulator where you don't play the hero, you pay the heroes! Operate the choppy waters of business ownership, hire adventurers, take contracts, and choose sides in the dangerous power struggles of the frontier.

games.name: Haunted Manager
games.summary: “If your fear is half-hearted, I will shut you down―――”My father, the head of the haunted mansion, said this to me on the first day of opening.

games.name: Heavy Hearts
games.summary: If humans are near extinction - and have become a rarity. In many cases, denizens would love to get their hands on one. Luccia's quest is to stop the decline of human civilization in this action RPG, where love and lust get in the way of the mission.

games.name: Hentai Sora
games.summary: Hentai Sora is a sensual puzzle game about a cold yet dangerously attractive girl. Solve levels, unlock explicit scenes, and slowly reveal her desires as the tension rises with every move.

games.name: Hired Stars
games.summary: HIRED STARS is an isometric single player RTS game in an open, randomly generated sandbox universe. You take control of a small mercenary force. Plunder trade routes, attack pirates, fight the Empire or follow the story. Conquer or buy new ships and equipment. Recruit new captains and level them.

games.name: Ho Ho & Move
games.summary: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.

games.name: Kasso Gaiden: Escape from the Skaterverse
Last Dolls
games.summary: Last Dolls is a roguelite horror game set in a dark fairytale world. Do you have what it takes to survive in a shattered world of dolls, scavenging supplies while evading monsters?

games.name: Loan Shark
games.summary: The loan shark is coming for you. Catch enough fish to repay your debt before it is too late. Go fish.

games.name: Love and Legends
games.summary: In a heartbeat, the ordinary becomes legendary. In a world of fantasy, where will your destiny and love lead?

games.name: Magic Sheep
games.summary: Get ready to fluff your brain and relax your heart, because this little sheep in a top hat is about to turn puzzle-solving into the cutest ritual of calm you’ve ever seen. Magic Sheep is a charming, slow-paced puzzle adventure where you push wooden barrels across peaceful gardens until each one rests perfectly on a marble pedestal. No pressure, no timer, only soft music, gentle thinking, and plenty of “oh, that was clever” moments.

games.name: Maid Cafe on Electric Street
games.summary: Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

games.name: Manairons
games.summary: Manairons is a 3D action platformer game inspired by the legends of little creatures living in the Pyrenees. Help Nai face off against the landowner who has taken control of a charming village using the power of the "canut," with magic, flute, and plenty of chaos.

games.name: Mitnal
games.summary: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.

games.name: Mole Cart Mining
games.summary: Get ready for an underground adventure full of charm and strategy! In Mole Cart Mining, you guide a determined little mole riding a mine cart while rotating tracks on a hexagonal grid to create the perfect route. The goal is simple and satisfying: collect every mineral and reach the exit in style.

games.name: Monkaru Fanta: Yuusha to Suishou no Shoujo
games.summary: Monkaru is an orthodox, retro-inspired turn-based fantasy RPG where you travel to defeat The Demon Lord with the help of a girl who was sealed in a crystal. The game is by Experience with character designs by Yuji Himukai and monster designs by Akifumi Yamamoto.

games.name: Monkey in the Zoo
games.summary: Step inside the cage. Banana drama guaranteed.

games.name: New Heights
games.summary: New Heights is a physics-based climbing and bouldering game.

games.name: No Sleep for Kaname Date: From AI - The Somnium Files
games.summary:
Kaname Date and the AI-Ball, Aiba tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game.
Examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies in "Investigation". Enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses in "Somnium". Solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms in the new "Escape" sections.
By moving between these three sections, obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

games.name: Oldest Golden Treasure
games.summary: Investigate the mysterious disappearance of your colleague in this thrilling VR escape room adventure. Every decision you make brings you closer to the truth... or further from it. Do you have what it takes to crack the case?

games.name: PC Building Simulator 2
games.summary: Grow your empire as you learn to repair, build and customize PCs at the next level. Experience deeper simulation, an upgraded career mode, and powerful new customisation features. Use realistic parts from 40+ hardware brands to bring your ultimate PC to life.

games.name: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death
games.summary:
A completely new title from Imagineer and Toybox Inc., Mystery Walk is the first in a three-part serial drama series!

The game is set in Narumisawa, a charming, fictional summer getaway town that feels familiar, as though you have seen it somewhere before…

The story alternates between the present and the past to uncover the truth behind an unsolved case from 30 years ago.

Told through a prologue, 10 episodes, and a mysterious “?” episode, the mysteries deepen with each chapter.

The fully voiced dialogue, brought to life by a talented cast, will make you eager to continue to the next episode. And there are some unexpected names among the voice actors…

Please immerse yourself in the world of Mystery Walk to the fullest!

games.name: Peaceful Fishing Story
games.summary:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.

games.name: Picronix 2
games.summary: Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles

games.name: Pocket Archery Master
games.summary: Test your agility and archery skills. Use bow to shoot targets, survive enemy waves.

games.name: Pools
games.summary: Liminal space game with focus on eerie exploration and immersion instead of typical horror. Navigate through endless alike rooms. Explore, orient, get out.

games.name: Questi Quest
games.summary: An endless runner with shoot-em-up mechanic.

games.name: Rain Debt
games.summary: A game about a kid who's forced to pay back his debt.

games.name: Ready, Set, Block!
games.summary: "Ready, Set, Block!" is a fast-paced PvP board game where players race to reach the opposite side first. Place blocks to slow opponents, use character abilities and items to outwit rivals, and plan your moves carefully in this turn-based, tactical race. Play locally, online, or vs AI.

games.name: Rebooted Fate
games.summary: Qin Nian, who had just graduated when the financial crisis hit and found himself unemployed at home, accidentally obtained a secret manual from an old beggar. Little did he realize that this manual would not only alter the course of his life but also lift a veil on the reality of the world.

games.name: Renegade X
games.summary:
Renegade X is a free Tactical Shooter that brings the Command and Conquer FPS experience to Unreal Engine 3. Renegade X is developed by Totem Arts, an independent group of Command & Conquer fans from around the world dedicated to bringing the world of C&C to you, up close and personal.

Two factions, the Global Defense Initiative (GDI) and the Brotherhood of Nod (Nod), are locked into a conflict over the green and mysterious resource Tiberium.
The primary game mode is Command & Conquer (C&C/CnC), where your objective is to destroy your enemy's base using any and all means necessary.

games.name: Rite of Eris
games.summary: Rite of Eris is a survival roguelike inspired by the likes of Vampire Survivors, Hades, and more. Unlock new characters, each with their own unique abilities, then jump into battle, unlocking powerful abilities along the way to aid your conquest against hordes of enemies.

games.name: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth
games.summary: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth is a rolling action game where you roll and squat your way back to Earth after being stranded in space.

games.name: Rusty Vein
games.summary: Rusty Vein is a 2.5D action-adventure game. Wearing a metal gauntlet, Rain sets out on a journey to defeat the mysterious doll legion that has occupied the town’s castle.

games.name: Saga & Seeker
games.summary: From a consumer of stories to a creator of them. Saga & Seeker is a "storycrafting game" where you can generate endless tales with your favorite characters. The words you write become a part of the story itself in this immersive entertainment experience powered by your imagination.

games.name: Sands of Aura
games.summary: Sands of Aura is an open-world action adventure with a fantasy setting of a realm in its twilight--a world buried beneath a sea of sand. Sail across the sandseas to return life to a dying world in an unforgettable experience that is equal parts engaging story and unrelenting, souls-like combat.

games.name: Shadow Corridor 2: Ame no Yohira
games.summary: Lost forever in the pitch black! But that's what makes it fun! The vast corridors covered in darkness change with each play. All you can do is run or hide from the frightening Apparitions. Use unique items and Karuta cards with special powers in your desperate search for an escape from the darkness!

games.name: Snapshot Oddities! Find What's Wrong
games.summary:
Can you spot something “off”?
A spot-the-oddity game where you hunt for strange details in images!

games.name: Snägäri Pinball
games.summary:
Snägäri Pinball is a classic 2D pinball game set in the late-night afterparty world of Finnish snack kiosks. Players control a single hand-drawn table designed around ramps, lanes, gates, ball locks, events, and score-chasing challenges.

The game features multiple visual and rule variations, including Finnish Mode, Over-The-Top Mode, and an Analog Horror Mode with CRT-style effects. Optional seasonal table themes add holiday and national celebration variants throughout the year.

A dedicated Kids Mode replaces adult humour and nightlife references with family-friendly art, music, and separate leaderboards. High scores, achievements, multiball events, and hidden secrets support replayability across different modes.

games.name: Sociable Soccer Champions
games.summary: Sociable Soccer Champions is an all-action carnival of fast-paced arcade football action.

games.name: Solnest
games.summary:
Solnest is a relaxing cat-finding adventure set in peaceful, sunlit, solarpunk-themed rooms. Explore all cozy levels to discover hidden cats in a beautifully drawn world.
500+ hidden cats to find across detailed scenes. 11 cozy rooms to explore, each bursting with solarpunk personality.

games.name: Spellcasters Chronicles
games.summary: CAST. FLY. FIGHT. COOPERATE. In intense 3V3 action-strategy battles, summon hundreds of creatures, cast devastating spells, and call upon the might of Titans to rise as the most powerful member of the community of Spellcasters – and shape the fate of the world. Together.

games.name: Subway Surfers City
games.summary:
Jump into the world of Subway City and play the newest endless running game. Conquer the new obstacles, reach new heights, and collect new characters! Jake, Tricky, Fresh and Yutani will take you on new adventures in Subway Surfers City.

Subway Surfers City brings an arcade runner quest with super-charged visuals, new characters, thrilling missions and more. Play now and run like never before!

games.name: Sushi Bar: Moebius
games.summary: A physics puzzle game. When you put sushi on top of sushi, the sushi you make will flow down the lane. Feed the customers and keep them full! When they are full, the next customer will come. The game is over when the sushi is out of the box! Aim for a high score!

games.name: Sweet Elf
games.summary: Sweet Elf - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and adorable elves. Enjoy the daily lives of these elves with relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

games.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered
games.summary:
Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced graphics and optimized gameplay!

Engage in the ultimate quest for self-discovery, remastered for the first time. The sacred kingdom awaits the arrival of its savior, and a lone woman named Velvet is marked by traumatic deceit. Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand

games.name: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma
games.summary: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.

games.name: The Fox's Way Home
games.summary: Before you know it, you find yourself in the realm between the hidden world and the real world. Rely on the guidance of the Fox shrine Maiden who lives there, and escape from the otherworld!

games.name: The Pancake Paradox
games.summary: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.

games.name: Tiny Garden
games.summary:
Tiny Garden, build your own magical garden inside a 90s toy
Plant your vegetables and trade them for furniture to customize tiny gardens in this delightful mix of farming, puzzle and strategy

games.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
games.summary:
Countless souls wander the ring road at night.
The title of “fastest” never fades, no matter how times change.

The stage of battle is a sealed future Tokyo.
Race through the night highways weaving through the city in your customized machine.
Defeat the countless rivals and aim to become the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

games.name: Towerborne
games.summary: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

games.name: Trials of Olympus
games.summary: Endure the Trials of the Gods in a fluid platforming adventure.

games.name: Vortex 9
games.summary: An online shooter with stylish brawlers, insane weapons, explosive shooting battles and cute pets! Supporting cross play with VR, mobile and desktop versions.

games.name: WEGO World War II: Overlord
games.summary: WEGO World War II: Overlord is an operational-level, ground-centric WEGOWW2 game system. This hex-based wargame recreates the Allied invasion of Western Europe. Includes 14 historical scenarios, from the landing at Omaha beach to a huge 135-turn campaign that covers the entire Normandy campaign.

games.name: Warlock Survivors
games.summary: Warlock Survivors is the battleground where you will face hundreds of thousands of enemies in a single frantic run. Upgrade your build and grab all resources you can to reach enough power to survive.

games.name: Waterpark Simulator 2025
games.summary: Life’s Better Soaked.

games.name: WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom
games.summary: How would you like to live of life of freedom in the Elnea Kingdom? Find solace in the company of unique residents, exploring, battling, collecting, farming, romancing, marrying, raising children, etc. Kick back, relax and enjoy yourself inside the life simulation game, WorldNeverland-Elnea Kingdom.

games.name: Yoshiko, Go to Your Relatives' House!
games.summary: Visiting a relative's house—it is a grand adventure. Presented by Satoru Gobunme, a creator with over 500,000 YouTube subscribers! Control the tragic heroine "Yoshiko Obune," overcome attacking strangers, traps, and exploding pandas to safely

games.name: Z Route: Redemption
games.summary: Post apocalyptic zombie action game that throws you into a relentless road war, where survival hinges on speed, precision, and split second decisions. Behind the wheel, you smash through barricades, mow down swarms, and pick between branching gates that hide supply caches or deadly ambushes. Each run pushes you forward toward redemption as you tune weapons, react to hazards, and keep momentum alive to outpace the horde.

games.name: Amazon Animals
games.summary: Amazonia Animals is a jigsaw puzzle featuring animals from the Amazon rainforest. Embark on a journey to the world's largest forest and meet endangered animals in beautiful hand-drawn 2D artwork

games.name: Apogee
games.summary: Apogee is a retro-style, physics-based arcade game where players navigate alone through an increasingly dense asteroid field.

games.name: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition
games.summary:
Aquamarine is a turn-based playable comic book about surviving in an alien ocean.

Inspired by the psychedelic sci-fi of the '70s & '80s, Aquamarine combines the mystery of old-school adventure games and challenging roguelikes with elements of survival, exploration, and puzzle solving.

Journey across a water world reclaimed by nature. Overcome survival and navigational challenges as you discover the planet's lost history. Master your pod's controls, study the ocean wildlife, and solve environmental puzzles to help you find your way home.

Cultivate a variety of alien plants with unique attributes. Forage the depths for food and salvage tools to help you survive. Collect and craft powerful upgrades for your humble escape pod, and customize your loadout to fit the needs of every plunge into the water.

You play as a lone space traveler known only as The Seeker. While orbiting an uncharted aquaplanet, your starcraft is disrupted by a strange signal and you're forced to eject. You crash land on a tiny island surrounded by an endless alien ocean, with nothing to help you but an amphibious survival pod. Throughout your underwater journey to reach your crashed ship, you'll uncover the planet's lost history and discover the true nature of why The Seeker ended up here.

games.name: Arrow World
games.summary: Guide the ever-moving cardboard "Hakoby" to the goal! Use infinitely placeable conveyor belts to create diverse solutions. A fresh puzzle experience that responds to Hakoby in real-time!

games.name: AutoBlobber
games.summary: AutoBlobber is a Roguelike Autobattler where you customize your Blob to survive endless waves of enemies. Strategically place upgrades, forge powerful synergies, and adapt your build between waves to push your run as far as possible.

games.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
games.summary:
You are a young adult adrift in life, suffocating under the yoke of your oppressive parents. Feeling out of sync with the rest of the world, you yearn for freedom and life beyond the bounds of your prison.

You find it in the form of a ravishing stranger and a long lost city, calling out to you across space and time. Something is beckoning underneath the ancient city's glimmering white tiles, something old and powerful. Someone.

Will you resist the call beyond the veil and the promise of belonging it brings, or will you let yourself go and embrace the path destiny has set before you?

The choice is yours. Magnustor is waiting for you.

games.name: Buy the Game, I Have a Gun: Sheesh-Man
games.summary: This game is an interactive movie telling the story of how I went on earth and became a super-hero or whatever, it's pretty sick if you ask me! Not sick in the sense that you will throw up, but in the sense that it's cool. This my friend was a word play, you can expect this level of humour in the game, may I say it even gets better than this, not a lot, but at least a little bit.

Play as an employee of the Candy Knights company whose job is to test the latest prototype in the field, the Candy Truck!

games.name: Cards and Castles Ultimate

games.name: Cat Cursor by Travellin Cats

games.name: Catx11
games.summary: Catx11 is a short incremental game. Harvest crops, buy upgrades, hire cats, fight bosses, and level up your gear! Many different strategies and ways to play.

games.name: Cozy Holes
games.summary: Play as Digby, a magical shovel left behind during an ancient calamity. Tunnel through layered biomes and uncover a heartfelt story through ancient carvings - etched by your lost shovel tribe in a whimsical tropical world.

games.name: Dracu-Riot!
games.summary: Welcome to the Special Administrative Region "Aqua Eden", an artificial island off the coast of Japan where casinos and more are legal.

games.name: Elf Clash
games.summary: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Defend Earth from the waves of alien invaders in this action-packed top-down shooter!

games.name: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix
games.summary:
Return to 2048 Hong Kong in the groundbreaking prequel that defined style and mature storytelling for a generation.

Set two years before the events of Fear Effect, dive into a sprawling adventure that takes you from futuristic cityscapes to the lost tomb of China's first emperor, and discover the origins of mercenaries Hana Tsu-Vachel, Royce Glas, Deke Decourt, and the enigmatic Rain Qin, in a story that blends high-tech espionage with ancient Chinese mythology and the supernatural.

games.name: Fishing Pro Simulator
games.summary: From quiet waters to rare trophies.

games.name: Furry Superstar
games.summary: Once a famous model, now a depressed middle-aged woman - there is no chance she's gonna get back to the top... Unless a young model agent-boy helps her to feel loved again!

games.summary: Are you ready to test your driving skills and your luck? Gas Ratio brings back the nostalgia of classic top-down arcade racers with a chaotic twist. In this game, speed isn't the only thing that matters—survival does.

games.name: Green Light

games.name: Gum Squad

games.name: Hamachi the Psychotic Killer
games.summary: Welcome to Hamachi the Psychotic Killer! In this platformer, you control Hamachi, a once-ordinary person now possessed by a demon with a craving for souls. Will you choose to spare the innocent or succumb to the urge to kill them all?

games.name: Hello, Runa!
games.summary: Wake up "Runa," an AI girl trapped in an old game console for 7 years. Experience a deep connection through dynamic animations and full voice acting for every line. Repair the system and discover the truth in this unique visual novel.

games.summary: Imperial Command is a turn-based strategy board game inspired by classics like Risk. Conquer a hex-based map, build your economy, and battle friends or AI in multiplayer—fully playable on Steam Deck.

You'll have use what you find to help you along your journey against many different enemies and bosses.

games.name: John's Quest
games.summary: You are John Appleby, video game historian. Your evil twin, "Evil John," is plotting dark schemes and causing a collision between genres! Only you have the power to restore peace and save gaming...

games.name: Just Dismantle
games.summary: Relax and unwind as you dismantle entire maps, piece by piece. Gather valuable resources to upgrade your tools and skills while unlocking new areas in this satisfying deconstruction simulator. No rush, no pressure – just pure dismantling.

games.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
games.summary: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains! Carefully plan production chains and satisfy various needs of your three-caste society while dealing with mountain hazards such as weather breakdowns and avalanches. Are you skilled enough to make your town thrive?

games.name: Liar's Dice
games.summary: Liar's Dice is an online realtime casual multiplayer bluffing dice game. Easy to learn, easy to master, always entertaining. Play with other players around the globe or invite and play with family or friends. Liar's Dice, also known as Dudo, Cachito, Perudo, Deception Dice, and Pirate Dice.

games.name: Lone Survivors
games.summary: Cut through hundreds of monsters and survive against all odds in this fantasy survivors-like top-down action game! Level up, unlock abilities, and defeat bosses with a wide arsenal of weapons and magic.

games.name: LumenKnight
games.summary: LumenKnight is a roguelike survival game with souls-like combat. Fight through challenging enemy waves and epic bosses. Test your reflexes, timing, and strategy in every fight. One life per run. Step in, embrace the challenge, and prove your skill.

games.summary: Assist Chief Medical Officer Samuel Edwards in performing TRIAGE, DIAGNOSIS, SURGERY on the crew aboard the TRH Rusanov.

games.summary:
Welcome to Meowgic Mix, an adorable pixel art puzzle where a floating cat on a living book must mix potions and deliver them to the correct cauldrons. There are 30 stages inside a magical academy, with challenges that require strategy, logic, and a good dose of feline cleverness.

Observe the classroom where each cauldron awaits its perfect potion. Push bottles, plan your route, and avoid getting stuck while solving each enchanted mini-puzzle. And if something goes wrong, no worries — undo or restart is always just a paw away.

Meowgic Mix combines charming pixel visuals, relaxing music, and mechanics made for players who love calm puzzles, cute animals, and a touch of fantasy. Get ready for a cozy, clever, purr-magical experience where every completed level is a tiny victory in feline alchemy.

games.summary: On a remote island community, nine cats wake up to find their humans gone. Ultimately, it is up to them to decide: "Are the humans worth bringing back?"

games.name: Pepper Grinder
games.summary: Pepper Grinder is an action-packed pirate adventure starring the titular Pepper, a seafaring soul with a passion for prospecting, and Grinder, her super-powered drilling device.

games.name: Pokémon FireRed Version
games.summary:
Pokémon FireRed Version and Pokémon LeafGreen Version are a pair of core series Generation III games that are set in the Kanto region. They were released in Japan on January 29, 2004, in North America on September 9, 2004, in Australia on September 23, 2004 and in Europe on October 1, 2004.

As the first remakes in the Pokémon franchise, the games revisit the original pair of Pokémon games, Pokémon Red and Green Versions, and so feature all of the characters, plot elements, and challenges of them, but with several important upgrades to bring them up to speed with other Generation III games.

The Game Boy Advance Wireless Adapter was initially included with the games when they were first released, eliminating the need for Game Link Cables when trading between the two games (and later Pokémon Emerald Version). In later copies, it was sold separately.

FireRed and LeafGreen went on to become the second best-selling games of the Game Boy Advance, only behind Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions. They also received Nintendo's Player's Choice awards.

games.summary: A stage-based turn-based strategy game where you read enemy moves and counter them under time pressure, then grow through item-driven builds with 89+ item synergies. Think fast, react faster!

games.name: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
games.summary: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard is the first game of the Resident Evil series to switch from 3rd-person to fully 1st-person perspective. A complete refresh of gameplay systems simultaneously propels the survival horror experience to another level. It is as much horror as it is survival, boosting up scare elements and minimizing downright shooting action. The game allows use of Sony's PSVR Headset to play in VR mode.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Resident Evil Village
games.summary: Resident Evil Village is a first-person survival horror game and the sequel to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard. The game maintains elements from previous Resident Evil games, with players having to scavenge environments for items and manage their resources. However, it adds more action-oriented gameplay, with higher enemy counts and a greater emphasis on combat.

games.name: Robo Rangers

Robo Rangers is a fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter where you take control of an elite combat robot. Fight your way through vibrant, handcrafted biomes, survive relentless enemy waves, and take down powerful bosses using a wide range of weapons and special abilities.

Every mission delivers intense, arcade-style combat that rewards quick reflexes, smart positioning, and tactical decision-making. Collect crystals, upgrade your gear, and evolve into an unstoppable Robo Ranger.

games.name: Ruins Of Fear
games.summary: Lucian wakes up on an ordinary school day to find himself in a deserted world. Together with Elora, he must solve puzzles, evade creatures in dark corridors, and uncover the mysteries around him.

games.name: Rusty Seas

games.name: Slime Wars

As you progress, your robotic suit evolves, granting new movement abilities that transform how you play. With smooth controls, distinct biomes, and a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack, Solar Machina offers a satisfying blend of challenge, rhythm, and exploration that keeps engagement from start to finish.

games.name: Soulshard
games.summary: In a realm between life and death, a confused soul, haunted by a life filled with misguided choices, seeks redemption and freedom.

games.name: Space Shooter
games.summary: A 2D arcade style Space Shooter where you traverse the galaxy hunting down the aliens who attacked your planet.

games.name: Sparrow Country
games.summary: Embark on a mystical journey as a Sparrow, exploring enchanted worlds and meeting new characters. Complete challenges to enhance your skills and progress through the game. Level up your character to increase size and capability. Earn XP by collecting stars, completing races and challenges.

games.name: Specter Hideout
games.summary: Specter Hideout is a top-down, asymmetrical multiplayer experience for 2 to 5 players. It pits a team of Hunters against one invisible Specter. Whether you are hunting the specter or "haunting the living", every match is a game of cat-and-mouse where one wrong move means the end.

games.name: Stick Out!
games.summary: Stick Out! is a precision platformer where you must use a spear to overcome obstacles by sticking yourself to walls and surfaces. Collect coins, buy skins, earn stars, and break time records! Can you complete every level?

games.name: Thaw
games.summary: Mine for ore, trace your memories, and mine again. When you reach the Snow Crystal at the lowest level, the long winter will come to the end. This gentle and quiet mining visual novel offers a small sense of accomplishment, perfect for sleepless nights.

games.name: The AI Bubble
games.summary: Survive the corporate hell where AI tries to replace you... literally. Play as a Junior Dev, collect absurd upgrades (like 'Paid in Exposure' or '144p Tutorial'), and destroy hordes of buggy robots in this satirical Action Roguelite / Bullet Heaven.

games.name: The Final Shift
games.summary: The Final Shift is a slow-burn psychological horror game where a janitor’s lonely night in an empty office building turns into a nightmare of looping floors, distorted realities, and haunting memories that refuse to stay buried.

games.name: The NewZealand Story: Untold Adventure
games.summary: The NewZealand Story comes back to life with Bitobit: experience the adventure of Tiki, the little Kiwi created by Taito in 1988, in a colorful 2D platformer full of challenges and nostalgia!

games.name: The Spooky Island
games.summary: A dark horror game in which the protagonist, Liam, embarks on an expedition to an island to find treasure and earn money. But the island holds secrets and horrors. Over time, the expedition turns into a nightmare from which he must escape...

games.name: Thekku Island
games.summary: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

games.name: Totenkampf: Anime Waifus vs WW2 Zombies

games.name: Trials of Randoom

games.name: Twisted Chance Online

Use tools, weapons, and environmental traps to survive… or embrace the terror.

games.name: What We Carry
games.summary: What We Carry is a dark, gothic strategy RPG where you can only see yourself. Walk a brave path through an unseen world, face random event cards, and survive the weight of every choice you make—if you can carry it.

games.name: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
games.summary: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

games.name: A Place Where Summer Rain Falls
games.summary:
️ “Everyone hides something.”
But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake.

'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold.

The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent.

games.summary: Explore 216 rooms of randomly generated hazards and enemies while collecting necessary artifacts in Castle of No Escape 2, a fantasy themed strategy RPG. Hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards - the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner.

Your strategy will shape their future.

Released as cartridge initially for the SEGA Mega Drive/Genesis in 2022, it has since appeared on cartridge for the Evercade, Nintendo Switch & PlayStation 4 (via Turrican Anthology Vol. 2) and as a streamable game on Antstream.

Listen to their requests, and figure out a way to fit them all into the pleasure mansion!

games.summary:
NECR: Chain Reaction Physics is a 2D physics-based skill game focused on one-shot mechanics and chain reactions.

The player launches a single core to interact with enemies and environmental objects. Collisions, explosions, and physics interactions create chain reactions that determine the final score.

The game emphasizes precision, timing, and player skill. There are no upgrades or pay-to-win mechanics.

Features include multiple enemy types, interactive elements such as bombs and teleports, and a global leaderboard for score competition.
